note: Indicative mapping from OWASP ASVS 5.0 to compliance controls, not an audit opinion. A mapped control shows where a requirement's evidence may help; it does not mean the control is met.

SOC2.name: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria
SOC2.titleNote: The criteria have no official short titles; each title is a short summary of the criterion text.

controls.CC6.1: Logical access security software, infrastructure and architectures protect information assets
controls.CC6.2: Users are registered and authorized before credentials are issued, and removed when no longer authorized
controls.CC6.3: Access is authorized, changed and removed by role, least privilege and segregation of duties
controls.CC6.6: Logical access security measures protect against threats from outside the system boundaries
controls.CC6.7: Transmission, movement and removal of information is restricted and protected
controls.CC6.8: Unauthorized or malicious software is prevented or detected
controls.CC7.1: Detection and monitoring identify configuration changes and newly discovered vulnerabilities
controls.CC7.2: System components are monitored for anomalies indicating malicious acts, natural disasters and errors
controls.CC8.1: Changes to infrastructure, data, software and procedures are authorized, designed, tested, approved and implemented
controls.C1.1: Confidential information is identified and maintained
controls.PI1.2: System inputs are controlled for completeness and accuracy

ISO27001.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A
ISO27001.titleNote: Control titles as named in ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A (and ISO/IEC 27002:2022).

controls.A.8.27: Secure system architecture and engineering principles

PCIDSS.name: PCI DSS
PCIDSS.titleNote: Requirements have no official short titles; each title is the opening of the defined approach requirement, shortened.

controls.2.2.1: Configuration standards are developed, implemented and maintained
controls.3.5.1: PAN is rendered unreadable anywhere it is stored
controls.3.6.1: Procedures protect cryptographic keys used to protect stored account data
controls.4.2.1: Strong cryptography safeguards PAN during transmission over open, public networks
controls.6.2.1: Bespoke and custom software are developed securely
controls.6.2.4: Software engineering techniques prevent or mitigate common software attacks
controls.6.3.1: Security vulnerabilities are identified and managed
controls.6.3.2: An inventory of bespoke and custom software and third-party components is maintained
controls.6.3.3: System components are protected from known vulnerabilities by installing security patches
controls.6.4.1: Public-facing web applications are protected against known attacks
controls.6.4.3: Payment page scripts loaded in the consumer's browser are managed
controls.7.2.1: An access control model is defined
controls.7.2.2: Access is assigned by job classification and function, with least privilege
controls.8.2.8: A session idle for more than 15 minutes requires re-authentication
controls.8.3.1: All user and administrator access is authenticated
controls.8.3.2: Strong cryptography renders all authentication factors unreadable in transmission and storage
controls.8.3.3: User identity is verified before modifying any authentication factor
controls.8.3.6: Passwords/passphrases meet a minimum length and complexity
controls.8.4.2: MFA is implemented for all non-console access into the CDE
controls.8.6.2: Passwords for application and system accounts are not hard coded
controls.10.2.1: Audit logs are enabled and active for all system components and cardholder data
controls.10.3.2: Audit log files are protected to prevent modifications
controls.12.3.3: Cryptographic cipher suites and protocols in use are documented and reviewed
